parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A wooden cabinet door attached to the front of the storage cabinet, typically rectangular and hinged on one side.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage space by swinging open and closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The main structural frame of the cabinet that supports all other parts.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and defines the overall shape of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A sliding wooden drawer located near the top of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to store smaller items and can be pulled out for access.
parts.Movement_description: It slides horizontally in and out along rails.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A flat wooden shelf inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and divides the internal space into sections.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Rectangle (Other)
parts.Basic_description: A rectangular internal structural component of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional support or separation within the cabinet structure.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move.

parts.name: Square (Other)
parts.Basic_description: A small square wooden component, possibly a connector or reinforcement piece.
parts.Functional_description: It strengthens joints or supports other parts of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The bottom base panel of the cabinet that supports the entire structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and supports the weight of the cabinet and its contents.
parts.Movement_description: It is stationary and does not move.
